title: Refine PR195 frame witness to κ = 0.000662832575455842015647
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Refine the pinned PR195 physical-frame witness to conditional
kappa = 0.000662832575455842015647, a 0.0272526% increase over
0.000662651985348746. Exactly 468 operation frames change; the scalar
word, aliases, deadlines, 46 terminal sinks and bit supplier are retained.

PR195 already implements arbitrary-subspace joins/intersections. This adds
an independent standard-library implementation and fixed proposal catalogue,
not a new move family or a record claim across other pending suppliers.
The PR195 seed commit and frame hash are pinned; its notice and all parent
attribution are preserved. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance is disclosed.
The original all-size analytic and compiler assumptions remain conditional.

The diff adds only research/subspace-bundle-frames and its dedicated CI workflow.
No selected result pointer, upstream file or existing proof package changes.
The builder extracts its pinned prerequisites automatically. Verification
requires neither discovery nor a local-investigation directory.

## Validation

Completed: full PR195 replay; exact new physical, sink, formal-column, moment
and 47-constraint assembly checks; clean Python 3.13 certificate replay;
byte-identical rebuild of all eight candidate inputs; small exact move tests
on Python 3.13 and 3.14; optimized-mode rejection; cold package review.

All repository `make verify` targets and explicit `make entrance-bank-verify`
passed. The historical OpenMP target required resuming with GCC 15; audit-only
Boost headers supplied another historical dependency. All 538 isolated tests
passed and all 2183 tracked baseline files remained byte-identical. The focused
26-file patch passes applicability, whitespace and isolated application checks. Linux CI is configured but has not
run because this PR has not been published. Finite checks do not formally
verify the full multiplication theorem.
